item.title: The Two-Dirham Geopolitics of Courgettes vs. The Infallible Barcodes of Inditex
item.description: Moroccan consumers will conduct a multilateral war of attrition over a 2-dirham margin on root vegetables, only to tap contactless cards for marked-up synthetic fast fashion with liturgical silence. An inquiry into barcode intimidation and domestic supply-chain rage.
